mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at overcast skies over Verona Community Park with a temperature of 61 degrees. The moon phase is a waxing crescent. Looking ahead, the temperature will drop to an overnight low of 52 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona has announced that two additional polling locations were approved last year. Please visit the My Vote Wisconsin website to check your specific ward and polling station before election day. City Hall staff are also available to answer any questions regarding the new map or your voting history.

There is plenty to do in Verona today, including the Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park and trivia challenges at The Mill and The Bogey Factory. Looking forward, don't miss the ART House 360 events happening tomorrow, or the Hop Haus trivia night also starting tomorrow.

In our weekly police report, we noted an incident that occurred on October 7, involving a motor vehicle crash on Basswood Avenue where a juvenile operating an electric motorcycle collided with a car during a turn. The report serves as a reminder to stay alert on our local roads.

Today's featured flavor at the Verona Culver's is the delicious Chocolate Caramel Twist. The restaurant is currently open for business and will remain open until 11:00 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
